- Initial release of the smyx-pet-training-command-execution-analysis skill.
- Analyzes pet training-area videos to detect Sit/Down/Stay command execution by comparing pet posture and command timing.
- Supports both local video uploads and online video URLs for server-side API calls.
- Provides execution reports with posture match scoring, response delay, and success/failure judgement; can trigger external repeat-prompt signals if not executed.
- Includes strict open-id validation flow and uniform cloud-based history report queries with Markdown table output.
- Designed for applications in smart dog-training devices, remote pet training, and behavioral correction.
